task_description: Build enhanced daily report (with CSV, improvement %, closing rate, ranking), new weekly report edge function + cron, and new monthly report edge function + cron. All reports include CSV attachments and individual salesperson emails (weekly/monthly).

verification.summary: bun run build passes. All 3 edge functions have valid Deno.serve exports, CSV attachments with base64 encoding, CRON_SECRET auth, and proper Resend API calls. Weekly and monthly cron SQL files have correct expressions ('30 3 * * 1' and '30 3 1 * *'). Monthly report queries user_targets for target vs actual. No test framework for edge functions - verified via syntax and pattern correctness. Code review fixes applied: btoa UTF-8 safe encoding, try/catch on individual email dispatch, .trim() on name lookups, allUserIds from both periods, CRON_SECRET descriptive error, time-to-close scoped to 180 days, RFC 4180 CSV quoting.
